name: Pineapple Jelly
description: Historical recipe from The Canadian Family Cook Book (1914). Source method; not modernized or kitchen-tested.

instructions.text: Soak gelatine in one cup cold water for one-half hour
Add the grated rind of two lemons to this and soak for fifteen minutes
Add sugar, juice of four lemons, two and one-half cups boiling water and pineapple juice
Let come to a boil and strain into a mould which has been soaked in cold water
Drop three-quarters cup chopped pineapple into the mould and set away to cool

source.author: Grace E. Denison
source.originalInstructions:
1. Soak gelatine in one cup cold water for one-half hour
2. Add the grated rind of two lemons to this and soak for fifteen minutes
3. Add sugar, juice of four lemons, two and one-half cups boiling water and pineapple juice
4. Let come to a boil and strain into a mould which has been soaked in cold water
5. Drop three-quarters cup chopped pineapple into the mould and set away to cool
